help.title: Help & User Guide
help.tip_workspace: Studio Workspace & Multi-Tab: Manage project folders with File Explorer, drag-and-drop tab ordering, and isolated 0ms RAM preview drafts.
help.tip_whisper: AI Whisper Offline: Transcribe Audio/Video (.mp3, .wav, .m4a, .mp4, .mkv) into Markdown 100% Offline with timestamps [mm:ss].
help.tip_ocr: PDF Scan OCR: Automatically extract text from scanned image PDFs into structured Markdown.
help.tip_batch: Batch & Archive Converter: Process entire folders or compressed archives (.zip, .rar, .7z) in parallel.
help.tip_history: Recent History & Welcome Dashboard: Pin important projects, filter and search recent file history.
help.tip_img_format: Floating Image Formatter: Right-click images in Live Preview to align Left/Center/Right and resize (100% synced with Word .docx).
help.tip_drag_drop: Smart Drag & Drop: Drag files from Explorer into the Editor to auto-insert Markdown links or embed images.
help.tip_youtube: YouTube Companion: Click timestamps [mm:ss] in Live Preview to seek video instantly in the Companion Mini Player.
help.faq_q1: How do I convert Word, PDF, Excel, PPTX files to Markdown?
help.faq_a1: Click 'Open Document' (Ctrl+O) or open a project folder. Convert quickly via the Ribbon bar or right-click files in File Explorer to choose your target export format.
help.faq_q2: How do I transcribe speech from audio/video files without Internet?
help.faq_a2: Open AI Model Hub on the Ribbon to download your preferred Whisper model once. Then click 'Transcribe Audio/Video' to transcribe completely offline and private.
help.faq_q3: Can the application process scanned image-only PDFs?
help.faq_a3: Yes — select 'PDF Scan (OCR) → MD' mode to automatically perform OCR text extraction on scanned PDF pages into clean Markdown.
help.faq_q4: How do I batch convert multiple files or .zip archives at once?
help.faq_a4: Go to File tab → 'Batch Convert...' or right-click any folder in File Explorer. The app supports recursive directory processing and direct .zip output packaging.
help.faq_q5: Where are auto-saved drafts and recent history stored?
help.faq_a5: Everything is safely stored in '%APPDATA%\DocConvert\', isolating drafts per tab and restoring your session seamlessly across restarts.
help.step1_title: Step 1 — Open Files, Project Folder or Media
help.step1_desc: Open single documents (Ctrl+O), open project folders in Explorer (Ctrl+B), paste YouTube/Drive links, or load Audio/Video for Whisper AI transcription.
help.step2_desc: Edit notes across independent tabs. Preview tables, Base64 images, and Mermaid diagrams in real-time with zero lag.
help.step3_title: Step 3 — Choose Conversion Mode or Format Images
help.step3_desc: Select target format (Word, Excel, PDF, PPTX, HTML, CSV, JSON, YAML) or right-click images in Preview to align Left/Center/Right.
help.step4_desc: Click 'CONVERT NOW' in the bottom action bar or use Batch Convert for entire directories.
help.step5_desc: Click 'Open File' or 'Open Folder' to view your results. All files and projects are organized in the Welcome Studio Dashboard history.
